page.overview:
What is Abomasnow?

Abomasnow is covered with thick white fur covering its mouth, but its hands, feet, and tail are dark green. It has gained four spikes on its back upon evolving from Snover. Its round eyes are light purple and angry-shaped and its eyebrows are actually large mounts of fur gathered in one place.

Females have longer fur covering their chest while male have shorter fur.

Abomasnow lives in snowy mountains and appears only when snow flowers bloom. Once the flowers die, it retreats to isolated areas. It is able to create blizzards to hide itself. It can also cause whiteout conditions with just a shake of its massive body. Abomasnow is also known as the "Ice Monster". It protects Snover from packs of Galarian Darumaka, who chase them for the Berries they grow; Abomasnow does so by swinging its arms like hammers.

Because they are -type Pokémon, Abomasnow tend to live in snowy mountains.
